**On-call handoff — gateway 503s**

**Root cause:** `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`. Connection pool fixed at `size 20`, all in use, wait queue growing unbounded (13 waiting at start, 172 by `03:55:58Z`). Matches deploy `dep-4471` (gateway, `a.novak`): *"config: connection-per-request for pool isolation"*, finished `2026-03-14T02:14:00Z` — first 503 followed 19s later.

**Impact window:** `2026-03-14T02:14:18.972Z` → still ongoing at end of available log data (`2026-03-14T03:59:27.974Z`), no recovery seen. Gateway only — `worker.log` shows no errors in this window, jobs completing normally.

**Rollback:** `dep-4471` on `gateway`.

Since the log cuts off mid-incident, confirm current prod status before handing off — can't tell from this file whether it self-resolved after `03:59`.
